documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in managed services. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing managed services client of Cedar Systems who is experiencing a workflow disruption caused by a recent configuration change. They explicitly stated that this is a support incident and requested that support be involved before any discussion of expansion. The operational friction they described is 'workflow stopped after a configuration change.'

claims.quote: Please get support involved before discussing expansion.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your workflow has stopped following a configuration change, and we appreciate your clarification that this is a support incident. Our support team is best equipped to assist with resolving this issue. Please allow them to engage directly with your team to address the disruption. Once the workflow is restored, we can revisit any expansion opportunities.
questions: Can you provide the details of the configuration change that caused the workflow disruption?
Have you already contacted the support team, or would you like us to escalate this to them directly?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the configuration change is not specified.
It is unclear whether the support team has already been contacted.
